description: Use when an agent watches new Solana meme coins. Input: optional minutes (5-60), limit (1-20). Output: JSON launch counts per 10 min from the pump.fun program, then the newest launches: mint, name/symbol, age, bonding-curve progress %, price and market cap in SOL, mint/freeze authority, holder aggregates (curve %, top-10 ex-curve %, dev %), riskLevel + signals. Aggregates only; no wallet lists. Not advice. Example: ?minutes=60&limit=10 Price: $0.0045 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.
name: sol_meme_launches
title: Solana meme launches: last hour of pump.fun tokens with bonding-curve progress and risk flags
